title: Welcome
conditional: Actual behavior depends on your device, permissions, and Android restrictions.

slides.title: Chat right after the call
slides.description: When any call ends, a WhatsApp shortcut appears so you can message the number directly without saving it as a contact.

slides.title: Incoming and outgoing
slides.description: Dughri supports incoming and outgoing calls and shows the shortcut when the call finishes.

slides.title: A quick floating shortcut
slides.description: A small card on top of your screen opens WhatsApp in one tap, and closes just as easily.
